title: "Welcome to Fire Service Data Science"
date: "2026-10-18"
categories: [news]
description: "Why this blog exists and what to expect."
---

Fire departments generate a lot of data: every call, every unit, every
timestamp. Most of it ends up in a report that gets filed and forgotten. This
blog is about putting that data to work.

## What to expect

- **Response time analysis:** where the minutes actually go, from call
  received to arrival on scene.
- **Station and unit coverage:** who can get where, and how fast.
- **Demand patterns:** when and where calls happen, and what that means for
  staffing.
- **Community risk reduction:** using data to target prevention where it
  matters most.

Posts include the R code behind every chart, so you can run the same analysis
on your own department's data.

## A note on data

Everything published here uses aggregated, de-identified, public, or simulated
data. Incident addresses and patient information never appear on this site.
